title: Shounen Maid: Onna wa Dokyou, Otoko wa Aikyou?
justification: AniList 87538 (SPECIAL, 1 episode(s) from 2016-08-24) is AniDB 11543's special(s) S1, aired 2016-08-24. AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 21321, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 11543, and the special's title matches an AniList title. On TMDB 66112 the parent's node places the special(s) where TMDB's dates disagree (AniDB S1 aired 2016-08-24, TMDB 66112 S0E1 2016-06-24), so the bridged record publishes no TMDB value.
